reviews.reason: Author review: this signature flags the child_process import and two spawnSync calls without tracing shell use. The renderer invokes Git, draw.io Desktop and Chromium using executable-plus-argument arrays, never a shell or diagram-supplied executable. DIAGRAM_BROWSER, DRAWIO_CLI, DRAWIO_CHECKOUT and PATH are trusted operator configuration, not untrusted request data. This is a false positive for shell command injection, not a general safety certification. Preserve the findings as INFO; require re-review if the file bytes or scanner version change.
